thread:
emma: Heads up 50% chance of a smoothie cart rolling by at 2pm. anyone want me to pre-order? :tropical_drink:
rishi: If it's mango + spinach count me in. also freezer door is rattling again  maybe the seal?
tara: Noted re: freezer. @facilities is out today so can someone open it gently and check for ice buildup?
ben: I can check after lunch. if it's the seal we should tag it "out of order" until fixed. last time it defrosted a bag of peas into a sad puddle.
olga: Smoothie vote: mango-spinach 3 votes, berry-banana 2. I'm team mango. Also can we have a "no straws" sign for the compost bin lids? they keep disappearing.
emma: I'll order 6 smoothies: 3 mango-spinach, 2 berry-banana, 1 green apple. paying and dropping a note with names. ETA 2:05pm.
kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: frozen fruit mix low (1 bag remaining). Freezer temp log: last stable reading 02:14. Suggested action: restock frozen fruit and inspect freezer seal. react :snowflake:
rishi: Thanks @kitchen-bot. Ben if you find mold or big puddles, please bag trash and tag maintenance.
ben: Opening now. small ice build-up on the left hinge but seal looks present. I cleared a chunk and set a towel down. no leaks. leaving a sticky: "Cleared ice at 12:40 by ben"
tara: Thanks Ben. Can we also put a small caution sign: "Freezer may make noise when defrosting" so people don't freak out at 6am?
olga: Smoothies arrived! Left a Post-it with names and a tiny "enjoy, share if you want" note. Also put the empties in the bin.
emma: Smoothie hero. Quick PSA: if you take someone else's, please leave a note or Venmo.
rishi: Smoothie was delicious. Also flagged maintenance ticket just now in case the seal worsens.
kitchen-bot: Action logged: maintenance ticket #4821 created for freezer seal inspection. react :white_check_mark:
ben: Cool. If maintenance schedules a time, I'll make sure facility access is granted.
tara: Tiny follow-up: can we get a second compost bin near the sink? current one overflows on green days.
emma: I'll add it to the weekly ambassador checklist. Thanks for the quick check, all. Smoothie-powered sprint resumes. :muscle:
